# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(HDF5Array)
library(zellkonverter)
library(SummarizedExperiment)  
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(sketchR)
library(AnnotationHub)
library(Signac)
library(ensembldb)
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
library(Seurat)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(GenomeInfoDb)})

SCRIPT_DIR <- getwd()   
PROJECT_ROOT <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")                     
DATA_DIR      <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data")
```

# 2. Load Files
```{r}
# Load objects you already have
seo <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "seo_annotated_paper.rds"))
sce <- readRDS(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", "sce_filtered_proteincoding.rds"))
consensus_peaks <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "consensus_peak_set_chr123.rds"))
PeakMatrix <- readH5AD(file.path(DATA_DIR, "peak_matrices/PeakMatrix-1-chr123.h5ad"))
```

# 3. Adapt Peak Matrix to workflow
## rowranges
```{r}
# Extract peak names
peak_names <- rownames(PeakMatrix)

chr   <- sub("-.*", "", peak_names)
start <- as.integer(sub(".*-(\\d+)-.*", "\\1", peak_names))
end   <- as.integer(sub(".*-(\\d+)$", "\\1", peak_names))

valid <- !(is.na(start) | is.na(end))

# Create GRanges
gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = chr[valid],
  ranges = IRanges(start = start[valid], end = end[valid])
)

# Assign metadata
mcols(gr) <- rowData(PeakMatrix)[valid, ]

# Subset matrix
PeakMatrix <- PeakMatrix[valid, ]

# Now assign
rowRanges(PeakMatrix) <- gr
```

## Build Peak names
```{r}
# Build rownames from GRanges coordinates
peak_names <- paste0(
  seqnames(rowRanges(PeakMatrix)),
  "-",
  start(rowRanges(PeakMatrix)),
  "-",
  end(rowRanges(PeakMatrix))
)

# Set as rownames
rownames(PeakMatrix) <- peak_names
```


## Adapt ATAC names
```{r}
# Normalize ATAC names
atac_names <- gsub(":", "_", colnames(PeakMatrix))
#atac_names <- gsub("-1$", "_1", atac_names)

# Set normalized names
colnames(PeakMatrix) <- atac_names
```

# 4.Carry-over gene annotation from Single Cell Experiment
```{r}
GeneExpressionMatrix <- seo
rdf <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::rowData(sce))
stopifnot(all(c("ENSEMBL","SYMBOL","SEQNAME") %in% colnames(rdf)))

# keep first non-NA entry per symbol
rdf_sym <- rdf[!is.na(rdf$SYMBOL) & rdf$SYMBOL != "", c("SYMBOL","SEQNAME")]
rdf_sym <- rdf_sym[!duplicated(rdf_sym$SYMBOL), ]

norm_sym <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(x))
  x <- gsub("^MT([A-Z0-9])", "MT-\\1", x)  # enforce MT- prefix
}

rna_assay <- "originalexp"
rdf_sym$SYMBOL_N <- norm_sym(rdf_sym$SYMBOL)
rna_feats        <- rownames(GeneExpressionMatrix[[rna_assay]])
rna_feats_N      <- norm_sym(rna_feats)

idx <- match(rna_feats_N, rdf_sym$SYMBOL_N)
CHR <- rep(NA_character_, length(rna_feats_N))
CHR[!is.na(idx)] <- as.character(rdf_sym$SEQNAME[idx[!is.na(idx)]])

mf <- GeneExpressionMatrix[[rna_assay]]@meta.features
if (is.null(mf) || nrow(mf) != length(rna_feats)) {
  mf <- data.frame(row.names = rna_feats)
}
mf$SYMBOL <- rna_feats                    # keep original symbols
mf$CHR    <- CHR
GeneExpressionMatrix[[rna_assay]]@meta.features <- mf

mapped <- sum(!is.na(CHR))
cat(sprintf("Chromosomes annotated for %d / %d RNA features (%.1f%%).\n",
            mapped, length(CHR), 100*mapped/length(CHR)))
if (mapped < length(CHR)) {
  unm <- head(rna_feats[is.na(CHR)], 15)
  message("Examples unmapped: ", paste(unm, collapse = ", "))
}
```

## Subsetting on chromosome 1, 2, and 3
```{r}
# filter GeneExpressionMatrix to genes on chr1–chr3
gene_chromosomes <- GeneExpressionMatrix[[rna_assay]]@meta.features$CHR
keep_genes <- gene_chromosomes %in% c("1", "2", "3")  
GeneExpressionMatrix <- GeneExpressionMatrix[keep_genes, ]
```

## Intersecting Cells
```{r}
common_cells <- intersect(colnames(GeneExpressionMatrix), colnames(PeakMatrix))

PeakMatrix <- PeakMatrix[, common_cells]
GeneExpressionMatrix <- GeneExpressionMatrix[, common_cells]

```
# 5. Subsetting with sketchR (not performed for now)
```{r}
rd <- reducedDim(PeakMatrix, "X_spectral_harmony")
idx_sketch <- sketchR::geosketch(reducedDim(PeakMatrix, "X_spectral_harmony"), N = , seed = 42)
length(idx_sketch)

PeakMatrix <- PeakMatrix[, idx_sketch]
GeneExpressionMatrix <- GeneExpressionMatrix[, idx_sketch]
```

# 6. create Seurat Object
```{r}
rna_assay <- "originalexp"  

# counts 
rna_counts_sparse <- GetAssayData(GeneExpressionMatrix, assay = rna_assay, slot = "counts")
if (!inherits(rna_counts_sparse, "dgCMatrix")) {
  rna_counts_sparse <- as(rna_counts_sparse, "dgCMatrix")
}

#atac_counts_sparse <- as(assay(PeakMatrix, "counts"), "dgCMatrix")
atac_counts_sparse <- assay(PeakMatrix)

# cell metadata (per cell)
cell_metadata <- GeneExpressionMatrix@meta.data
stopifnot(identical(rownames(cell_metadata), colnames(rna_counts_sparse)))

# gene metadata (per feature)
gene_metadata <- GeneExpressionMatrix[[rna_assay]]@meta.features
stopifnot(identical(rownames(gene_metadata), rownames(rna_counts_sparse)))

# Create Seurat object with RNA assay and cell metadata
seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = rna_counts_sparse,
  assay = "RNA",
  meta.data = cell_metadata
)

# Create and add ATAC assay
peak_ranges <- rowRanges(PeakMatrix)
atac_assay <- CreateChromatinAssay(
  counts = atac_counts_sparse,
  ranges = peak_ranges,
  genome = "hg38"
)
seurat_obj[["ATAC"]] <- atac_assay

src_chr <- GeneExpressionMatrix[["originalexp"]]@meta.features$CHR
names(src_chr) <- rownames(GeneExpressionMatrix[["originalexp"]])

# align to features present in the new object
rna_feats_new <- Features(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA")
src_chr <- src_chr[rna_feats_new]

# add as feature-level metadata to the RNA assay (Assay5)
seurat_obj[["RNA"]] <- AddMetaData(
  object   = seurat_obj[["RNA"]],
  metadata = src_chr,
  col.name = "CHR"
)

md <- seurat_obj[["RNA"]]@meta.data
rownames(md) <- Features(seurat_obj, "RNA")
seurat_obj[["RNA"]]@meta.data <- md

stopifnot(identical(rownames(seurat_obj[["RNA"]]@meta.data),
                    Features(seurat_obj, "RNA")))

attach_gene_annotation <- function(obj, genome = "hg38", keep_chrs = c("chr1","chr2","chr3")) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86))
  edb <- EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86
  gr  <- genes(edb, columns = c("gene_id","gene_name"))
  gr  <- keepStandardChromosomes(gr, pruning.mode = "coarse")
  old <- seqlevels(gr); new <- paste0("chr", sub("^MT$", "M", old)); names(new) <- old
  gr  <- renameSeqlevels(gr, new)
  if (!is.null(keep_chrs)) {
    gr <- keepSeqlevels(gr, intersect(seqlevels(gr), keep_chrs), pruning.mode = "coarse")
  }
  GenomeInfoDb::genome(gr) <- genome

  # ensure peaks carry same genome label
  pr <- granges(obj[["ATAC"]])
  GenomeInfoDb::genome(pr) <- genome
  obj[["ATAC"]] <- SetAssayData(obj[["ATAC"]], slot = "ranges", new.data = pr)

  # attach
  Annotation(obj[["ATAC"]]) <- gr
  obj
}

seurat_obj <- attach_gene_annotation(seurat_obj)

# Add X_spectral_harmony embedding as a DimReduc object
spec_embed <- as.matrix(reducedDim(PeakMatrix, "X_spectral_harmony"))
rownames(spec_embed) <- colnames(PeakMatrix)

spec_reduc <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = spec_embed,
  key = "SPEC_",
  assay = "ATAC"
)
seurat_obj[["spectral"]] <- spec_reduc

seurat_obj$leiden <- PeakMatrix$leiden[match(colnames(seurat_obj), colnames(PeakMatrix))]

# Save fully annotated Seurat object
saveRDS(seurat_obj, file.path(DATA_DIR, "seo_RNA_ATAC_chr123.rds"))
```
